text: exit code 2 is overloaded in this CLI — it means both unknown command and usage error — so a test asserting a command exists cannot key on it; the MUTATES membership test compares against Object.keys(COMMANDS) instead

author: agent
text: The board page now refreshes from the CLI dispatch after any mutating command, so it can no longer go stale between merges. src/cli.ts carries a MUTATES set beside COMMANDS (init, migrate, add, start, stop, done, log, ask, answer, edit, link — uninstall deliberately absent because it deletes the page), and main() calls refreshBoardPage only when the handler returned 0, so a refused command does not render on its way out. refreshBoardPage is best-effort and swallows everything: a page that cannot be written must never fail a mutation that already landed on disk, and cairn render --check stays the thing that reports staleness out loud. Writes go through a temp file and rename, which cairn render now shares, rather than taking the board lock — the refresh runs after the command released it and a nested withLock would spin its full 5s deadline first. No git hook changed, so HOOK_VERSION stays 3 and no repo needs cairn init --hooks; the fix arrives on npm upgrade. Found live: next.scrapcycle.org rendered on 2026-08-07 and then drifted three weeks to a page claiming 34 open and 9 closed against 51 open, 1 doing and 18 done on disk. Re-rendered, that board grows from 34 to 52 open rows, and its dead ends go 5 to 16 and open questions 0 to 3 — the stale page was hiding the two sections that carry the memory value. 127 tests.
